preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: The input consists of lines of text.

preconditions.expression: len([line for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() == '0']) >= 1
preconditions.description: The input ends with a line containing exactly '0'.

preconditions.expression: all(int(line.strip()) >= 1 and int(line.strip()) <= 100000 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != '0' and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()[1:] if len(line.split()) > 1))
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with an integer n where 1 <= n <= 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(set(map(int, line.split())) == set(range(1, int(prev_n) + 1)) for prev_n, line in zip([int(l.strip()) for l in stdin.splitlines() if l.strip() != '0' and not any(c.isdigit() for c in l.split()[1:] if len(l.split()) > 1)], [l for l in stdin.splitlines() if l.strip() != '0' and any(c.isdigit() for c in l.split()[1:] if len(l.split()) > 1)]) if len([l for l in stdin.splitlines() if l.strip() != '0' and any(c.isdigit() for c in l.split()[1:] if len(l.split()) > 1)]) > 0 else True)
preconditions.description: Each permutation line contains exactly the integers from 1 to n, each appearing exactly once.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip().splitlines()) == len([line for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != '0' and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()[1:] if len(line.split()) > 1)])
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line in ['ambiguous', 'not ambiguous'] for output_line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'ambiguous' or 'not ambiguous'.

postconditions.expression: all((output_line == 'ambiguous') == (perm[i] == perm.index(i + 1) + 1 for i in range(len(perm))) for output_line, perm in zip(stdout.strip().splitlines(), [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != '0' and any(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()[1:] if len(line.split()) > 1]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'ambiguous' if and only if the permutation is equal to its inverse permutation.
